title: Module Summary: Getting Started with Python

concepts.name: Python
concepts.description: A high-level programming language known for readable syntax and broad use in scripting, automation, data work, and applications.

concepts.name: Interpreter
concepts.description: A program that executes code directly by reading and running instructions rather than producing a separate compiled binary first.

concepts.name: Script
concepts.description: A file of code intended to be run as a program or automation task.

concepts.name: Expression
concepts.description: Code that evaluates to a value, such as a calculation, variable reference, or function call.

concepts.name: Statement
concepts.description: A complete instruction in a program, such as an assignment, conditional, loop, or function call.

concepts.name: Standard library
concepts.description: The collection of modules included with Python that provide common functionality without extra installation.

concepts.name: Python REPL
concepts.description: An interactive Python session where code is entered and evaluated one statement or expression at a time.

concepts.name: Script execution
concepts.description: Running a saved program file so the interpreter executes its statements in order.

concepts.name: Terminal command
concepts.description: A text command entered in a shell to run programs, navigate files, or perform development tasks.

concepts.name: Syntax error
concepts.description: An error caused by code that violates the grammar rules of the programming language.

concepts.name: Runtime error
concepts.description: An error that occurs while a program is executing, even if the code syntax is valid.

concepts.name: Program output
concepts.description: Text, values, files, or behavior produced by a program when it runs.

concepts.name: Variable
concepts.description: A name that refers to a value stored or computed by a program.

concepts.name: Assignment
concepts.description: The act of binding a value to a variable name.

concepts.name: String
concepts.description: A sequence of text characters stored as a value.

concepts.name: Integer
concepts.description: A whole-number value without a fractional part.

concepts.name: Float
concepts.description: A numeric value that can represent decimal or fractional quantities.

concepts.name: Boolean
concepts.description: A true-or-false value used in logic and control flow.

concepts.name: Type conversion
concepts.description: Changing a value from one data type to another, such as from text to a number.

concepts.name: print()
concepts.description: A Python function that writes text or values to the console output.

concepts.name: input()
concepts.description: A Python function that reads text entered by the user from the console.

concepts.name: Prompt
concepts.description: Text shown to a user to ask for input or guide an action.

concepts.name: String interpolation
concepts.description: Inserting variable values or expressions into a string to produce formatted text.

concepts.name: User input
concepts.description: Data provided by a person while a program is running.

concepts.name: Console output
concepts.description: Text or values displayed in the terminal or command-line interface.
